description: Source code for Windows-specific memory threshold eviction notifier in Kubernetes kubelet, handling memory usage monitoring and eviction triggering on Windows systems.

classes.name: windowsMemoryThresholdNotifier
classes.description: Struct implementing memory threshold notification logic for Windows in Kubernetes.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the notifier, launching a goroutine to periodically check memory usage.

methods.name: checkMemoryUsage
methods.description: Checks current memory usage and triggers events if threshold is crossed.

methods.name: UpdateThreshold
methods.description: No-op for Windows; method required by interface.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string describing the current memory eviction threshold.
